PRIMARY_OUTER_SPLIT_AUTHORITY: OUTER_DATE_GROUP_ID (calendar recording date; date-safe across sources)

outer_date_group_definition.unit: calendar recording date (DDMMYY); a/b session suffix merged to the same calendar date
binding_rules: cross-source dates 281119 & 291119: all CVAT + legacy units of that date stay in ONE outer fold (never split by source)
101219a & 101219b: same calendar date (Dec-10) -> bound to ONE outer group unless proven independent sessions

id_columns_to_emit.session_group_id: camera x date x source (CVAT video / legacy day-source session)
id_columns_to_emit.inner_recording_group_id: video_key / burst-group (678 total) used only for inner validation within outer-train

outer_fold_recommendation.issue: 3 dates = 89% of units, CVAT-dominant; 11 legacy tokens = 11%; naive leave-one-date-out is unbalanced (hold out 291119 = 44%; tiny legacy dates test <100 units).
outer_fold_recommendation.recommended: claim-grade leave-one-date-out over the 3 LARGE dates {291119,301119,281119} (each a real test fold) + ONE pooled small-legacy-dates fold; report per-date with support and CI.
outer_fold_recommendation.effective_outer_generalization_units: 4 inferential outer folds (FOUR_FOLD_DATE_GROUPED_OUTER_CV) -> LOW statistical power; 13 dates reported descriptively
outer_fold_recommendation.source_comparison_note: only 281119 & 291119 enable within-date cross-source comparison (train-one-source/test-other diagnostics)
outer_fold_recommendation.naming_correction: This is a 4-fold date-grouped outer CV (3 single large-date folds + 1 pooled small-date fold). It is NOT full leave-one-date-out and must not be called that.

inner_validation: recording session / video / burst-group within outer-train (678 groups available)
leakage_rules: no neighboring temporal intervals across train/test
collapse overlapping windows to native units before scoring
split_purity_checks: no temporal_unit_key spans two outer folds
no object_track_key spans train/test in same fold
no calendar date spans two outer folds
SPLIT_PURITY: SPEC_READY (to be validated by a build-time audit before training)
descriptive_per_date_reporting: Report descriptive (NON-inferential) per-date results for ALL 13 calendar dates; the 10 small legacy dates are pooled into F4 for inference because individually they have too few units for a stable held-out fold.
